name: Rue des Gestes — étape 3 · pousser, glisser, pendre
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (man pushing three cats in a wheelbarrow, penguin sliding down a wooden slide, woman at her loom by the lantern on the balcony, grocer weighing one pea on brass scales at the upper window), -ir/-re RIGHT (man hanging a pendulum clock by his door; singer interrupted by a squawking parrot on the balcony). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
